metric_basis: AIPerf total input+output tokens/s / 24; p95 TTFT in seconds

interactivity_definition.population: Successful profiling requests with finite positive E2E and OSL; excludes warmup, errors and cancellations.
interactivity_definition.threshold_origin: User-selected engineering criterion; not a dataset requirement.

simulation_scope: Native DynoSim V10 only; all 12 hardware policy/concurrency settings matched with one frozen build and engine.
